text_block_list.text:
With a succession of races lately, I went 
for a walk to catch my breath... when a 
fan called out to me.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you for the cheers! Allow me 
to answer them in kind...—with an opera of 
gratitude!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... D-Did you see those smiles? 
It seems my radiance has answered their 
calls once more!
choice_data_list:
Don't you get tired of thanking people 
with an opera every single time?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Noblesse oblige... Even on overcast days, 
the sun continues to rise to illuminate 
the world.

"On top of running races, she's carrying 
fatigue from fan service. ...Should I 
reconsider her upcoming race schedule?"
